inputs.name: Elementary cyclotomic local-field background
inputs.author: J. S. Milne
inputs.title: Algebraic Number Theory
inputs.theorem_reference: Proposition 6.2 and the local-field theory in Chapter 7; the required Eisenstein and index argument is written in HV2.
inputs.accepted_statement: Finite cyclotomic extensions and their Galois actions; uniqueness of a local valuation and the usual original-place decomposition groups.
inputs.exact_specialization: For K/Q_ell of degree <=b, the actual cyclotomic image has index <=b. The finite-level surjectivity, compact inverse-limit step and valuation bound 1+v_ell(a)+v_ell(e)<=3be are proved in HV2.

inputs.name: Abelian conductor-discriminant formula already matched in TW-CD
inputs.author: Romyar Sharifi
inputs.title: Iwasawa Theory, Chapter 4
inputs.accepted_statement: The absolute discriminant of an abelian number field is the product of the conductors of its characters.
inputs.exact_specialization: The actual field F=ker(psi) intersect ker(cyc mod ell) lies in Q(mu_(ell N)), so Delta_F <= (ell N)^[F:Q]. This is used only in HV5.
